definitions.explanation: Height measured from mean sea level. Used to express the elevation of land, mountains, or locations.

examples.japanese: {海抜|かいばつ}ゼロメートル{地帯|ちたい}。
この{町|まち}は{海抜|かいばつ}{約|やく}500メートルにある。
examples.english: This town is at about 500 meters above sea level.

examples.japanese: {富士山|ふじさん}の{山頂|さんちょう}は{海抜|かいばつ}3,776メートルで、{日本|にほん}で{最|もっと}も{高|たか}い。
examples.english: The summit of Mt. Fuji is 3,776 meters above sea level, the highest in Japan.

notes: Typically used in the pattern {海抜|かいばつ}〜メートル (... meters above sea level). The synonym {標高|ひょうこう} is more commonly used in geography and mountaineering contexts, while {海抜|かいばつ} is more general and commonly seen on signs and in everyday descriptions. {海抜|かいばつ}ゼロメートル{地帯|ちたい} refers to areas at or below sea level, which are at risk of flooding.
